acceptanceCriteria.text: One internal gh-inari companion client resolves explicit Issue and PR identities through the supported canonical get contract.
Repository identity is explicit and independent of unrelated cwd.
Returned typed data includes the minimal governed semantic fields plus validity/classification and artifact/governance provenance required by downstream C2 freshness.
Mottainai does not reparse artifact Markdown or duplicate template/governance validation rules.
Invalid, ambiguous, wrong-template, missing, incompatible, and malformed companion results fail closed with bounded diagnostics.
Packed process tests exercise the real supported gh-inari machine surface.
Retrieval is read-only and introduces no direct GitHub mutation fallback.

issue.title: feat: resolve governed task artifacts through the gh-inari companion
